verses.text: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

segments.text: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath;
Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

verses.text: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.

segments.text: For thine arrows stick fast in me,
And thy hand presseth me sore.

verses.text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

segments.text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation;
Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

verses.text: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

segments.text: For mine iniquities are gone over my head:
As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.text: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, Because of my foolishness.

segments.text: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt,
Because of my foolishness.

verses.text: I am pained and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

segments.text: I am pained and bowed down greatly;
I go mourning all the day long.

verses.text: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.

segments.text: For my loins are filled with burning;
And there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.text: I am faint and sore bruised: I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

segments.text: I am faint and sore bruised:
I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.text: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.

segments.text: Lord, all my desire is before thee;
And my groaning is not hid from thee.

verses.text: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

segments.text: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me:
As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.

segments.text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague;
And my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.text: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And meditate deceits all the day long.

segments.text: They also that seek after my life lay snares
for me
And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things,
And meditate deceits all the day long.

verses.text: But I, as a deaf man, hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

segments.text: But I, as a deaf man, hear not;
And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

verses.text: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.

segments.text: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not,
And in whose mouth are no reproofs.

verses.text: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope: Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.

segments.text: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope:
Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.

verses.text: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

segments.text: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me:
When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

verses.text: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.

segments.text: For I am ready to fall,
And my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.text: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

segments.text: For I will declare mine iniquity;
I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.text: But mine enemies are lively, and are strong; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

segments.text: But mine enemies are lively,
and
are strong;
And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.text: They also that render evil for good Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.

segments.text: They also that render evil for good
Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.

verses.text: Forsake me not, O Jehovah: O my God, be not far from me.

segments.text: Forsake me not, O Jehovah:
O my God, be not far from me.

verses.text: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.

segments.text: Make haste to help me,
O Lord, my salvation.

headings.text: A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.
